metrics.model_requests: Recorded HTTP model requests only; null when not recorded. Never inferred from turns, messages or tokens.
metrics.artifact_tool_calls: Executed inventory/read operations: list_artifacts, read_docx, read_pdf and read_xlsx. Excludes report completion.
metrics.completion_calls: Recorded finish_report tool calls for Pi or parsed finish_report actions in Mini's turns.
metrics.agent_turns: Adapter-native agent rounds; not an HTTP request or efficiency proxy.
metrics.adapter_tool_calls: Original trajectory.tool_calls. Pi includes completion; Mini excludes it.

normalization.pi_artifact_count: Sum recorded list_calls, docx_reads, pdf_reads and xlsx_reads only when all four exist.
normalization.mini_artifact_count: trajectory.tool_calls, checked against parsed artifact actions when turns are available.
normalization.mini_completion_count: Number of turns with action=finish_report; unknown when turns are unavailable.

aggregation.value: Sum only when every unit records the metric; otherwise null.
aggregation.known_subtotal: Sum over recorded units only, or null if no unit records it.
aggregation.coverage: Always report known_unit_count, unit_count and complete.
